quests.name: The Catapult
quests.offer:
An old catapult, its fuse dry, aimed at nothing. The guards on the bridge would surely come running.
Light the fuse?

steps.journal: The fuse is lit. Get over the bridge while the guards are off it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Rallos Zek (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 1 and 2. The guide's popup on approaching the bridge is a sign at the bridge's foot (no way to open a box for a passer-by). The guards run to the fire for 75 s (ours) and go back.

quests.name: The Mark of Rallos
quests.offer:
The post knows the Mark on you. The portal beyond it wakes for the Mark, and the Mark goes through last.
Press the Mark to the post?
quests.accept: Press the Mark to the post.

steps.journal: Press the Mark of Rallos to the signpost by the portal in the back corner.
steps.reminder: The post wants the Mark of Rallos.

events.text: The portal will not wake: another raid fights him.
The portal will not wake: another raid fights him.

steps.journal: When your raid has gone through the portal, go last: it takes the Mark and closes behind you.
steps.waiting: It takes the Mark, and closes behind you.

choices.says: The portal takes the Mark, and closes.

choices.answer: No, there are more to come.
choices.says: The portal holds a little longer. Come back when you are the last.

steps.journal: Have at him. All three of his forms, and good luck.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Rallos Zek (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 6 and 7. The guide gives no reward but the fight and its loot (the forum's ZP Loot Table). A raid at a time: its lock 'rallos zek' holds until he falls, 2 h pass or the isle stands empty 10 minutes.
